name: Haus Cäcilia
beschreibung:
Located in the idyllic alpine village of Serfaus, Haus Caecilia provides comfortably equipped holiday apartments boasting lovely mountain views. It is a wonderful home base for family adventures.

The village underground, the Serfaus ski lifts, and scenic footpaths are within easy walking distance.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Caecilia in Serfaus features cosy apartments in a peaceful sunny spot on the high plateau.
